newsitem.title: USA: Penn to cut 325 jobs in reorganization.
newsitem.headline: Penn to cut 325 jobs in reorganization.

text.p: Penn Traffic Co said on Tuesday it will lay off about 325 non-store employees and take pre-tax charges of $11 million in the first quarter and $2 million in the second quarter from a reorganization intended to cut operating costs by $12 million per year.
The company also said it would take a pre-tax charge of $4 million in the first quarter from "in connection with the retention of recently hired corporate executives."

The employees to be laid off work in division headquarters in Columbus, Ohio and DuBois, Penn. Fifteen employees will relocate to the main office in Syracuse as Penn Traffic centralizes its management, the company said.
Penn Traffic in a separate statement said its first quarter revenues were down 8.3 percent from a year ago. Full financial results from the quarter will be released on June 2.
The company said its nonfoods purchasing and merchandising department will remain in Columbus.
Penn Traffic operates 265 supermarkets in upstate New York, Ohio, Pennsylvania and West Virginia, with 27,000 employees.
